summary: Crash when setting LodestonePos of compass to something other than NBT compound
description: The bug The game crashes when changing or creating a compass item with a LodestonePos having a value other than an NBT compound tag. [^(20w17a) crash-2020-04-23_21.44.55-server.txt] Description: Ticking player java.lang.ClassCastException: lp cannot be cast to la at bhr.a(SourceFile:144) at bje.a(SourceFile:454) at bcw.j(SourceFile:290) at bcx.l(SourceFile:575) at anz.h(SourceFile:2217) at bcx.h(SourceFile:274) at ys.i(SourceFile:411) at zj.b(SourceFile:199) at ma.a(SourceFile:234) at zi.c(SourceFile:171) at net.minecraft.server.MinecraftServer.b(SourceFile:839) at net.minecraft.server.MinecraftServer.a(SourceFile:766) at enn.a(SourceFile:89) at net.minecraft.server.MinecraftServer.run(SourceFile:625) at java.lang.Thread.run(Thread.java:745) How to reproduce Do this in a test world /give @s compass{LodestoneDimension:"minecraft:overworld",LodestonePos:"This is not an NBT compound"} The game freezes and you will see in the log file that it has crashed
Steps to Reproduce:
1. Launch Minecraft in any version where the bug is reported to occur.
2. Create or load a test world in Creative mode with default settings.
3. Use the following command to give yourself a compass: `/give @s compass{LodestoneDimension:"minecraft:overworld",LodestonePos:"This is not an NBT compound"}`
4. Observe that the game crashes after executing the command.
5. Check the log file for crash details, specifically noting the `crash-reports/*.txt` file for further information.
6. Take a screenshot or record the exact moment of the crash to document the issue.
7. Note any additional observations from the crash logs or screenshots.
Observed Behavior: The game crashes when attempting to change or create a compass item with a LodestonePos value that is not an NBT compound tag. This issue occurs specifically in version 20w17a, as evidenced by the crash log file "crash-2020-04-23_21.44.55-server.txt." The error message indicates a `java.lang.ClassCastException: lp cannot be cast to la` at various points within the source files related to player ticking and item handling. To reproduce this bug, perform the following steps in a test world: use the command `/give @s compass{LodestoneDimension:"minecraft:overworld",LodestonePos:"This is not an NBT compound"}`. The game will freeze upon execution, and the log file will indicate that the game has crashed due to this invalid input for LodestonePos. This behavior highlights a critical issue where the game fails to handle non-NBT compound values correctly in the compass item's LodestonePos tag.
Expected Behavior: When following the reproduction steps, the game should not crash and should allow the creation or modification of a compass with a LodestonePos value that is not an NBT compound tag. The player should be able to use the compass without any issues, and the game should remain stable and responsive.
